verdict.rationale: Qdrant is an API-first service: the docs and GitHub describe a convenient API to store, search and manage points, list official client libraries in six languages, and show documented quickstart calls such as create_collection. The OpenAPI probe found no spec on the marketing site, but that does not contradict the documented API. Missing for 10: an explicit API reference or machine-readable OpenAPI spec in the evidence, and independent hands-on corroboration of programmatic control beyond a brief client-usage mention.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: It provides a production-ready service with a convenient API to store, search, and manage points—vectors with an additional payload.
Qdrant offers the following client libraries to help you integrate it into your application stack
Go client ... Rust client ... JavaScript/TypeScript client ... Python client ... .NET/C# client ... Java client
Just played with qdrant using its Python client. Pretty smooth onboarding experience
